'''Jaco''' (Japanese: '''ユースケ''' ''Yūsuke'') is a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}} and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP042|The Electrike Company]]''.

Jaco was a student at the [[Pokémon Training Center]] for {{type|Electric}} Pokémon, where he was trying to train an {{p|Electrike}}. They were the only ones that had not yet graduated because Electrike couldn't control its electricity. He met {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} when his Electrike shocked him while trying to perfect its {{m|Thunderbolt}}.

Jaco actually preferred {{type|Flying}} Pokémon over Electric-types and believed his Electrike was doomed for failure. However, {{an|Brock}} didn't believe it and said Electrike was stronger than others. Jaco proved his lack of knowledge after trying to brush Electrike with a metal brush, only to get zapped by the built-up static energy. With the help of Ash, {{an|Dawn}}, Brock, and even [[James]] and {{MTR}}, Jaco and Electrike developed a closer [[friendship]], and it was able to use its Thunderbolt perfectly. Later, against what James and Meowth wanted, [[Jessie]] attempted to steal Electrike. However, it evolved into {{p|Manectric}} and was able to stop Jessie. Jaco's teacher {{OBP|Cal|DP042}} was impressed by what he and Manectric had done and graduated them on the spot.
